recordingBy: Recording for the transcript · started by {name}
consentTitle: Record the session for its transcript?
consent: Everyone in the meeting will see that the session is recorded, and anyone can leave their turn out. The sound is sent to the speech-to-text service of the workspace, then deleted; only the text is kept with the session.
sourceTab: The video call (a browser tab, with its sound)
sourceTabHint: Pick the tab of the call and tick “Share tab audio”.
noSound: No sound to record: the shared tab has no audio.
denied: The browser did not give access to the sound.
optOut: Leave my turn out of the transcript
optedOut: Your turn is left out of the transcript.
title: Transcript
allow: Allow recording the sessions for their transcript
allowHint: The host starts the recording from the control room; everyone sees it and can leave their turn out. The sound is deleted once transcribed.
notReady: Set up a speech-to-text service in the workspace settings first.
